why: स्रवति 'flows away' fits the simile of water from a broken boat; भवति would make no sense.
तत्र + इदम् = तत्रेदम् 'there all this is set', correct sandhi and sense.
Line-initial syllables before the first udatta are all marked anudatta, as elsewhere in this edition.
इयम् agrees with नदी ('this river flows'); वयम् would be ungrammatical here.
स्वयम् 'himself' is the natural reading with उपशृणुयात्.
वरेयम् 'bride-wooing' is a regular word in the marriage hymn; sense and accent fit.
Refrain repeated 27x; the svarita on मे॑ after udatta द is missing here only.
इह + इमे = इहेमे, correct sandhi; 'here these heroes'.
विद्वां before a vowel is the regular sandhi form of विद्वान्; the metre needs no extra syllable.
तमसा 'by darkness' pairs with स्वप्नेन 'by sleep'; तपसा would not fit.
Refrain repeated 26x; svarita on र्भ॑ after udatta निर् is missing here only.
Refrain repeated 26x with पु॒त्रम॒सौ (anudatta before udatta सौ); म॑ svarita here breaks the accent sequence.
ब्रह्मभिः + स्तोम- loses the visarga before स्त; 'with prayers, bearing praise' is correct.
ब्रह्मणः + उज्जभार gives ब्रह्मण उज्जभार; regular visarga sandhi.
शृणीहि 'crush' is used in the same hymn (मृणीहि, शृणीहि); fits sense.
A list of datives (मनसे चेतसे धिये आकूतये चित्तये) continuing into the next line.
अनु + अद्य = अन्वद्य; 'may Anumati approve today'.
Genitive ब्रह्मणः with ककुदात् 'from the summit of brahman'.
Svarita on ब्र॑ follows udatta सा exactly as in the preceding line सा ब्र॑ह्मज्यं.
Nominative list with च: आपश्च वरुणश्च राजा; matches the dative list in the next line.

suggest: जि॒तम॒स्माक॒मुद्भि॑न्नम॒स्माक॑मृ॒तम॒स्माकं॒ तेजो॒ऽस्माकं॒ ब्रह्मा॒स्माकं॒ स्वऽर॒स्माकं॑ य॒ज्ञो॒३ऽस्माकं॑ प॒शवो॒ऽस्माकं॑ प्र॒जा अ॒स्माकं॑ वी॒रा अ॒स्माक॑म् ॥
why: Refrain repeated 25x; svarita on भि॑ after udatta मुद् is missing here only.
मनवे 'for Manu' is the dative the sentence needs (dawn shone for Manu).
अस्तु + अद्य = अस्त्वद्य; regular sandhi.
मनवः nominative plural, subject of ईषिरे with प्रजावन्तः.

suggest: इ॑रेव नो॑प दस्यति समुद्र॑ इव प॑यो मह॑त्।
why: इरेव (इरा + इव) is fine, but समुद्र॑इव lacks the word space and the accent marks of this and the next line differ from the edition's usual pattern; may be a source quirk.
एतु + ऋतम् = एत्वृतम्; 'let the snare reach him, who harms truth with untruth'.
वि वेष्टय 'strip off (the skin)' parallels सं छिन्धि; वेपय would not fit.
इन्द्रम् अस्य रायः, accusative object of ईमहे with genitive; correct.
प्र + इन्द्रस्य = प्रेन्द्रस्य with वोचम्; regular sandhi.
विशताम् 3sg imperative with subject वर्णः; correct.
विध्यत 'pierce (that army)' addressed to the Maruts; fits the before line.
नि विशन्ते with जनासः, present middle plural; correct.
अदेवः सन् चिकीर्षति 'being godless he seeks to act'; the next line confirms the hostile subject.
स्वेन महसा 'by your own greatness' addressed to barley; sense fits.
आ विशति 3sg with subject पक्षी; correct.
आ विश imperative addressed to Indra; correct.
Rare house-part term in the hall hymn; nothing in grammar or neighbours suggests इन्द्रस्य.
वामस्य 'of the lovely (bird)' with पदं वेः; sense fits.
गुपिताः 'guarded' with इमाः; valid participle of गुप्.
विशन्तु 3pl imperative with ताः; correct.
Two svaritas in a row (स्मा॑न् ब्र॑) is an impossible accent sequence; the 45x form has udatta स्मान् followed by svarita ब्र॑.
पविता 'purifier' with पुनातु; सविता would not fit Vaishvanara.
Vocative जातवेदः takes svarita on जा॑ after the udatta of ते; consistent.
परि ष्वजामहे is the regular retroflex sandhi of परि + स्वजामहे.
यद् इष्वा 'what by arrow' parallels यद् दण्डेन and यद् वारु; correct.
Vocative सूर्य takes svarita after the udatta of बट्; consistent with the other vocatives in the line.
हि + एतत् = ह्येतत्; regular sandhi.
विभुम् accusative agreeing with अग्निम् वैश्वानरम्; correct.
Accents are internally consistent (पतिं॒ anudatta before accented दधा॑तु); an edition reading, not a stray mark.
पथिकृद्भ्यः dative plural in a series of datives with ऋषिभ्यः, पूर्वजेभ्यः.

suggest: अश्वि॑ना॒ ब्रह्म॑णा यातम॒र्वाञ्चौ॑ वषट्का॒रेण॑ य॒ज्ञं व॒र्धय॑तौ ।
why: ब्रह्म॒णा after anudatta ना॒ puts udatta on ब्र and then anudatta on ह्म, an impossible sequence, but the next line shows the same pattern so it may be the source.
प्रविद्वान् 'knowing well' with उप याहि; a regular compound.
भवतु imperative with मा कनीयः; 'let it become more, not less'.
Accented भव॑ति after udatta ज्या is a valid udatta-udatta sequence; sense 'tongue is the bowstring' fits.
भवन्ति plural with पञ्च रुक्माः; correct.
तव + इदम् = तवेदम् 'this all is yours'; correct.
लो॒क॑मु॑ has a svarita directly after an anudatta and then a second svarita, an impossible sequence; क should carry the udatta of लोकम्.
अयम् nominative with प्रागात् 'this (amulet) has come'; correct.
भयम् 'fear' as object of आ दधताम्; fits the hostile context.
भवन्तु 3pl imperative with विश्वे देवाः; correct.
